title: 3D-Printed Carbon Black Sensors Improve Piezoresistive Performance
summary: Researchers investigated carbon black and Ecoflex nanocomposite sensors fabricated using a 3D printing-assisted technique to enhance piezoresistive performance.

title: Theoretical Study Explores Plastic Shot Blasting
summary: Researchers analyzed plastic shot blasting as a surface hardening method for metals that minimizes roughness and avoids microcracks.

title: Potatoes Grown in Simulated Lunar Dust
summary: Researchers have successfully grown potatoes in simulated lunar regolith, potentially enabling future moon base farming.

title: Hybrid-Bonded 3D NAND Boosts In-Memory Compute Density
summary: Researchers from IBM, Micron, and the University of Patras published a paper on a hybrid-bonded 3D-NAND-flash-based analog in-memory-compute macro.

title: Kleox Reveals Tiny Expanding Teardrop Camper Trailer
summary: Kleox has developed an all-new expanding teardrop trailer that measures under 10 feet long and stretches out at camp to sleep two people.

title: Boom Supersonic Fires Up Prototype Engine Core
summary: Boom Supersonic has successfully fired up the prototype core of an engine designed to power its Overture airliner and data center turbines.

title: UK Infrastructure Unprepared for Worsening Climate Impacts, MPs Warn
summary: UK MPs warned during a debate that transport links and emergency services are not ready for frequent flooding, heatwaves, droughts, and wildfires.

title: The Sovereign AI Paradox and Compute Control
summary: U.S. restrictions on overseas AI infrastructure could accelerate sovereign computing and impact technology dominance.

title: Enterprises Favor On-Premises AI Infrastructure
summary: More than half of large organizations surveyed plan to own at least some AI infrastructure due to data privacy and regulatory concerns.

title: AICTE and Nemetschek Partner for AEC Skills
summary: The partnership will establish centers of excellence at 15 institutions to support training for 150,000 students.

title: Secure Flash Aids Cyber Resilience Act Compliance
summary: Winbond's TrustME W77Q Secure Flash helps OEMs meet EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements for connected products.

title: SoC Architectures Redefine Smart Meters for Modernized Grids
summary: Texas Instruments is enabling electric meters to utilize system-on-chip architectures to evolve into intelligent edge hubs supporting a modernized grid.
